newsitem.title: SUDAN: 42 drown after boat capsizes in Sudan - paper.
newsitem.headline: 42 drown after boat capsizes in Sudan - paper.

text.p: Forty-two people drowned in northern Sudan when their boat capsized on the way to religious celebrations marking the ascension of Islam's Prophet Mohammad, a newspaper reported on Monday.

Al-Ingaz Al-Watani reported that 27 women and 15 children drowned and four people survived the accident on Saturday near Shendi on the river Nile, about 140 km (80 miles) north of the capital Khartoum.
It did not say why the boat overturned.
